issues.description: `sys` is imported in mathdecl.py but not in mathimpl.py files where `sys.version_info` is referenced
issues.detail: In `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py`, the diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` blocks but does not show `sys` being imported. If `sys` isn't already imported at module scope in those files, this will raise `NameError` at import time on all Python versions. Verify or add the import.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-guard mechanism: uses raw `sys.version_info` in source but `PYVERSION` constant in tests
issues.detail: The codebase exposes `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` (used in the test). The new source-level guards use `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` directly, which is inconsistent with the project's convention. Use `PYVERSION` everywhere for consistency and to match how Numba handles other version-dependent features.

issues.description: `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` mutates the shared class registration
issues.detail: In `mathdecl.py`, reassigning `Math_unary` after the decorator chain rebinds the module-level name to the decorator's return value. While `infer_global` typically returns the class unchanged, this pattern is fragile and unusual — every other unary math function uses a dedicated `@infer_global` decorator on its own class declaration. Prefer the standard pattern for clarity.

issues.description: Missing newline at end of release note file
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` is created without a trailing newline (`\ No newline at end of file`). Many doc tooling pipelines and linters require trailing newlines; fix by adding one.

issues.description: Blank line removed before `@infer_global(math.atan2)` reducing readability
issues.detail: The diff removes the blank line separating `Math_unary`'s signature list from the next class. With the new `if sys.version_info` block immediately followed by `@infer_global(math.atan2)`, there's no visual separation. Add a blank line after the conditional block.

issues.description: Test x_values include negative inputs but no values that exercise large/edge behavior
issues.detail: `test_exp2` reuses the `exp` test's value list `[-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` (note duplicated -2). Consider including 0, a larger value (e.g., 10), and verifying the duplicate `-2` was intentional. Not blocking but worth tightening.

review.summary: The PR adds `math.exp2` support following the existing `math.exp` pattern, which is reasonable. Main concerns: (1) `sys` is imported in `mathdecl.py` but the diff for both `mathimpl.py` files uses `sys.version_info` without showing an import — likely a `NameError` if `sys` isn't already imported there. (2) Version guards use raw `sys.version_info` in source but `PYVERSION` in tests — inconsistent with project convention. (3) The `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` rebind pattern is non-idiomatic compared to all other unary math registrations. (4) Missing trailing newline in the release note file. Overall the change is small and tractable but needs cleanup before merge.
